in_sanskrit.name: नेमिचंद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नेमिचंद (nemichand) - the one who gives pleasure or delight

in_hindi.name: नेमिचंद
in_hindi.long_meaning: नेमिचंद (nemichand) - the one who gives delight or pleasure, the one who is always pleased, the one who is a source of joy and happiness, the one who is a boon or a blessing

in_tamil.name: நெமிசந்தன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: நெமிசந்தன் (nemisandan) - the one who gives delight and joy to those who perceive him, the one who is always kind and compassionate

in_telugu.name: నేమిచంద్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: నేమిచంద్ర (nemichandra) - the one who is the lord of delight and pleasure, the one who is the source of eternal joy and happiness, the one who is the embodiment of desire and desire fulfilled

in_marathi.name: Nemichand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nemichand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nemi (Lord of the Mind) + Chand (Moon God) Nemichand is a name of Lord Hanuman, who is the embodiment of devotion and courage. In Hindu mythology, Hanuman is known to have the power to control the mind and senses.

in_bengali.name: Nemichand
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Mind
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nemichand একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nemi (Lord of the Mind) + Chand (Moon God) Nemichand is a name of Lord Hanuman, who is the embodiment of devotion and courage. In Hindu mythology, Hanuman is known to have the power to control the mind and senses.
